description: CONFORMANT variants of the admission-policy algebra, for the advanced tier of exercise 11.2. Each entry rewrites one :core snippet WITHOUT changing what the algebra decides, so a suite that pins only the contract stays green on all of them; a test that fails here is a false alarm. Legality rests on the advanced tier's contract addendum: policies are pure, so evaluation order and the number of evaluations are outside the contract, and a combinator captures its list at construction. Two entries (allof-no-short-circuit, allof-defensive-copy) also appear in the mutant catalogs as spec-dependent: in the basic tier the learner decides those questions, in the advanced tier the addendum has decided them. Regenerate with ./gradlew generateVariants; score a suite with ./gradlew verifyVariants -PmutantTests=<learner|path> --continue.

variants.find: override fun admits(duck: Duck): Boolean = policies.all { it.admits(duck) }
variants.replace: override fun admits(duck: Duck): Boolean = policies.map { it.admits(duck) }.all { it }
variants.what: AllOf asks every policy instead of stopping at the first rejection.

variants.find: override fun admits(duck: Duck): Boolean = policies.any { it.admits(duck) }
variants.replace: override fun admits(duck: Duck): Boolean = policies.map { it.admits(duck) }.any { it }
variants.what: AnyOf asks every policy instead of stopping at the first acceptance.

variants.replace: override fun admits(duck: Duck): Boolean = policies.reversed().all { it.admits(duck) }
variants.what: AllOf consults its policies back to front.
